narrative.overview: This records the built module/seam hover readout and shared detailed-readout styling only. The established instrument is precise, quiet, and machined: open divisions, technical names, and tabular figures. It does not establish a new product-wide visual direction. [Instrument standards](docs/instrument-standards.md) and their pinned prototypes remain authoritative; [the surface brief](docs/module-hover-readout-design.md) owns this readout's content contract.
keyCharacteristics: One reserved reading beside the board.
Output hierarchy and aligned chord figures.
Open rows with explicit state text and silent-participation markings.
dos: Do keep the instrument standards and pinned prototypes authoritative.
Do align figures, preserve every active instance, and make idle and uncertified states explicit.
Do preserve complete Hex-detail and placement-preview facts when reusing shared styling.
donts: Don't introduce enclosing pills, nested row boxes, or decorative glow in this readout.
Don't repeat the aggregate chord multiplier in ordinary module hover.
Don't treat unavailable browser checks as verified evidence.
